exploit_name: Changes to Pyth entropy provider allow attacker to fix jackpot result
description: Switching Pyth entropy providers mid-draw allows attacker to select a malicious provider returning predetermined numbers.
root_cause: Switching Pyth entropy providers mid-draw allows attacker to select a malicious provider returning predetermined numbers.
fix_description: Freeze entropy provider changes while a draw is active.
notes: Attacker can guarantee specific jackpot results.
